retainedCorrection: Diagnostic-only bounded reuse of seven logical artifact labels; all metadata operations execute. No shipped runtime correction.

methodology.http: Sequential fresh server processes, separate client, same Contact installer, empty dataset, no spacing, concurrency 12, unchanged 1000 ms Page deadline. Ten off windows plus seven-mode alternating three-round matrix per series; three JSON off and three extended controls. Separate serial equal-work controls.
methodology.off: All optional observers disabled. Existing fixture request/admission bookkeeping and unconditional production Page diagnostics remain. Off native-operation counts, Page elapsed and exhaustion are unobserved, never zero.
methodology.modes: Minimal HTTP diagnostics are the common base for loop/filesystem/canonical/guard/extended. Loop adds histogram/ELU only, no async hook. Filesystem adds async correlation only. Canonical and guard hooks select disjoint target groups; extended reproduces existing G attribution.
methodology.reconciliation: Fresh authorized provider query after all responses, limit 20 > 12 writes, initially empty data. Aggregate records, not a per-response write-ID mapping or proof of exactly-once delivery.
methodology.calibration: Three fresh processes per version; nine alternating measured rounds after one warmup, 30000 resolved Promises and 70000 stub metadata calls. No Contact/real filesystem cost. Paired label controls: three processes, twenty warmup pairs, nine measured pairs, identical 70000 invocations. Synchronous elapsed includes OS/native/GC, not exclusive CPU.
methodology.limits: No statistical tail bound or causal reliability claim from success-count changes. Memory snapshots include fixture/JIT/provider state; no GC PerformanceObserver or allocation profile installed. Builtin Page diagnostics remain production overhead. Baseline monitor controls were finalized during off-mode captures; no off-mode behavior changed. Serial controls follow correction and are not before/after pairs.
